title: In repos/activity-api/src/routes/execution-traces.ts, the GET '/decision-calibration' route cannot be windowed by time.
description: In repos/activity-api/src/routes/execution-traces.ts, the GET '/decision-calibration' route cannot be windowed by time. It parses activity_id, source, min_decisions, limit and offset, then always runs a fixed bounded scan `ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT $decision_cap` with `const DECISION_CAP = 20000;` over the decision_outcome table. Add optional `start_date` and `end_date` query parameters to that one route. When present, push them into the existing `conds` array as `created_at >= type::datetime($start_date)` and `created_at <= type::datetime($end_date)` with matching entries in `params`, exactly like the sibling GET '/selection-outcomes' route already does for `sel.selected_at`. Echo the two bounds back in the existing `window` object of the JSON response alongside `decision_cap`. Leave the aggregation helper aggregateDecisionCalibration untouched — this is only about bounding which decision_outcome rows are scanned. The purpose is to make calibration-over-time computable: comparing actual_reach_rate in an early window against a later window is how the substrate can tell whether its own predictions are improving.
